title: Global dimension is tested on finite modules and on cyclic modules
statement: Let $R$ be a ring and $n\ge0$ an integer. The following are equivalent [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension]: (1) $R$ has global dimension $\le n$, i.e. every $R$-module has a projective resolution of length $\le n$; (2) every finite $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] has a projective resolution of length $\le n$; (3) for every ideal $I\subseteq R$ the cyclic $R$-module $R/I$ has a projective resolution of length $\le n$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 065T (lemma-finite-gl-dim, line 26856), whose proof uses Lemma lemma-colimit-projective-dimension (line 26800)
